gate_reason: 42% of claims score Low (43/103), placing this stage in the 30–70% Low band requiring ship-with-flag. The High-confidence claims are well-sourced: US/Canada cargo theft loss figures (CargoNet/Verisk), ATRI industry cost data, FBI PSA, FHWA truck parking shortage, Munich Re/TAPA APAC SEA incident data, and CONCAMIN/Mexico multi-source corroboration form a credible factual core for PP5.1, PP5.2, and PP5.3. The Low-confidence cluster is concentrated in two identifiable buckets: (1) 16 ASSUMED-tagged claims covering all SEA-specific operational assertions — these are structurally unresolvable without primary field interviews and should be clearly labeled as hypotheses-to-validate, not findings; (2) 6 market sizing figures from unverified aggregators (DataIntelo, Ken Research, MarketIntelo, Grand View, Research and Markets) that carry no independent corroboration and should be stripped from any external-facing output until replaced. No single critical claim in the pain-point headlines is sourced exclusively from an aggregator or vendor — the headline loss figures and theft trend statistics are robustly sourced. The stage is shipable for internal orientation purposes with explicit flags on the aggregator market sizing numbers and the ASSUMED SEA operational claims.
